name: TabArena-Lite-v0.1
selection: Official first split of every v0.1 dataset: repeat 0, fold 0, native split number 0.

sources.finding: The Lite predicate selects split == 0, explicitly fold 0 and repeat 0.
The Lite selection maps to SplitMetadata.get_split_index(repeat_i=0, fold_i=0).
Paper TabArena-Lite contains all datasets with one outer fold; figure bench:full-lite

row_count_note: Native metadata train/test counts are fold averages and may be fractional. Actual selected row IDs and counts are validated from each OpenML split archive at generation time; no rows are rounded or removed.
